Metadata.title: Godee – Learn English vocabulary
Metadata.description: Learn English vocabulary by topic and CEFR level with flashcards, English definitions, Vietnamese meanings and smart review scheduling.

Footer.note: Godee · A personal, non-commercial learning project. Dictionary data: Wiktionary, WordNet, Tatoeba (CC BY-SA / CC BY).

Landing.title: Learn English words and keep them
Landing.lede: A few minutes of flashcards a day: English definitions, the Vietnamese meaning to check against, and a schedule that brings each word back just before you would forget it.
Landing.demoTap: Tap the card to see the meaning
Landing.learnBody: Every word comes with IPA, audio, an English definition and example sentences. Skip the ones you know, add the rest, then take a quick quiz.
Landing.reviewBody: After each card you rate it Again, Hard, Good or Easy. The FSRS algorithm schedules each word's next review: the better you know it, the longer until you see it again.
Landing.trackBody: Your daily streak and goal, how well you know each word, and your progress by topic and level.
Landing.ladderLabel: Time between reviews of one word
Landing.ladderCaption: A word you always remember: each review pushes the next one further away (illustrative).
Landing.levelsLede: Every word has a level from A1 (beginner) to C2 (proficient), so you study at the right level.
Landing.topicsLede: Family, food, work, travel, technology… Each topic splits into smaller subtopics.
Landing.closeTitle: Start with your first 10 words today
